title: Instances unhealthy: 400 on health check
briefing: A new environment came up, but every instance is Unhealthy and visitors cannot reach the app.

artifacts.logs: ALB target health check is failing with HTTP 400.

options.text: Configure ALLOWED_HOSTS so it also accepts the Host header used by the health check
Set DEBUG = True so the health check passes
options.why_wrong: DEBUG does not bypass Host validation.

options.text: Change the health check path to /
options.why_wrong: The path is fine; the request is rejected before routing because of Host validation.
The application is responding instantly with 400, so waiting longer changes nothing.

explanation: The load balancer health checker sends a Host header that Django rejects because it is not present in ALLOWED_HOSTS.
lesson: A 4xx on a health check means the app was reached but rejected the request.
hints: Look at the exact Host header in the health-check request.
Which Django setting validates the Host header?
